title: Lesson 1 Quiz: Algorithmic and Automated Trading Explained

questions.text: What is the primary function of an algorithmic trading bot when its predefined conditions are met?
options: It waits for a trader's manual approval before acting.
It automatically executes the corresponding buy or sell order.
It analyzes news articles to predict market direction.
It adjusts its strategy based on current emotions.
questions.explanation: The bot follows its programmed rules and sends the order instantly without human intervention or emotional influence.

questions.text: Automated trading bots guarantee profitable returns for users.
questions.explanation: Bots execute the given strategy faithfully; a flawed strategy will result in losses, so automation does not ensure profit.
